adobe_api.scope: No new Adobe route. Unqualified adaptiveWideAngle actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB descriptors reject. Existing rendered raster output remains available.

limitations: Exact Adobe output, resampling/colour/edge semantics, live controls and physical macOS14/26/Intel qualification remain open. Latest desktop evidence remains locked, without bypass/re-probe.
No camera/lens manufacturer database, automatic EXIF As Shot, Adobe settings interchange or calibrated Photomerge panorama matching. Auto is a documented heuristic, not profile matching.

Current8,388,608-input-pixel limit,64 constraints/128 total segments/32 points per constraint. Unsupported antipodal or horizon-crossing arcs reject instead of silently changing projection. Larger image performance remains open.
RGB8/16 use encoded samples; RGB32 uses linear pixels as a native extension. Full Photoshop document colour-mode/filter matrix is not implemented.

Fixed canvas extent can crop corrected geometry. Complex later geometry filters, folded meshes and all interactive edge cases remain unqualified. Mesh constraints use bilinear interpolation while rasterization triangulates cells.
Editable PSD/PSB and Adobe descriptors remain unsupported. Native31 preserves settings/source editability; raster exports remain available.
Magnifier/detail panel, complete constraint keyboard/context interactions, Photoshop preset interoperability and exact workspace styling remain outstanding refinements.

Optimized/full regression/universal packaging is batched at the F05 milestone. Step185 is the last universal candidate; Lens Correction and Adaptive Wide Angle are currently source/Debug changes. Full F05 remains open.
